short: LM proposals scored by an fMRI encoding model (M06) were ahead in 2022 and later overtaken; the GPT prior (M07) is standard; one test story and anatomical-only privacy tests limit the claims.
position: The paper [@tang2023] changed the decoding search (M06), the use-time prior (M07) and the use-time action (M04). M06 was ahead in 2022: no earlier non-invasive language decoder in the ledger scores language-model proposals with a forward encoding model (Appendix), and it holds in each of three subjects; direct brain-to-embedding guidance [@zhao2024] has since overtaken it on the same data. M07 and M04 are standard by precedent [@affolter2020; @martin2014]. The language-model null is the right control for generative decoders, but all perceived-speech numbers come from one test story. Meaning-level reconstruction holds; word-level, invasive-parity and mental-privacy claims go beyond the tests.
